exercises.question: Which sentence means "If Puerto Rico were a state, its citizens would elect senators with a vote"?
options: Si Puerto Rico fuera un estado, sus ciudadanos elegirían senadores con voto.
Si Puerto Rico es un estado, sus ciudadanos elegirían senadores con voto.
Si Puerto Rico sería un estado, sus ciudadanos elegirían senadores con voto.

exercises.sentence: Si Puerto Rico __ un país independiente, tendría su propia política exterior.
exercises.english: If Puerto Rico were an independent country, it would have its own foreign policy.
If Puerto Rico chose free association, it would sign an agreement with the United States.
